run_enjoy_custom_env: run the enjoy script to evaluate a custom RL policy in a custom environment using SampleFactory
run_main_entry: run the main entry point that registers custom components and starts policy evaluation
review_enjoy_workflow: review the enjoy workflow that registers components, parses args, and evaluates the APPo policy
refactor_main_for_testing: refactor the main function to accept a custom config instead of parsing CLI arguments
test_custom_enjoy_script: test the custom environment enjoy script by running evaluation with a trained checkpoint
